_notes: age_terms: words that mean a child, an age group or a size or height standing in for age; any of them makes a request a cannot.
boy and girl usually mean a child, so they count. Job titles that use them for adults (delivery boy, office boy) are in not_age_phrases and never count.
Drawn zone and line names (a kids play area) are places, not ages, and are masked before the check.
age_reason: I can't tell anyone's age, and I never watch children as a group.
age_alternative: anyone in that place, anyone alone there, or anyone not moving there for a while
fallback_reason: None of my building blocks can see that.
fallback_alternative: someone in a zone, crossing a line, staying too long, or looking like something you describe
night_colour_caveat: This camera sees in black and white at night, so colours are only judged by day.

attributes.plate_text: a vehicle's number plate as read, for example MH12AB1234; 'unread' when it could not be read
attributes.plate_colour: a vehicle's number plate colour: white (private), yellow (commercial, so taxis and cabs), green (electric), black (self drive rental), or unknown at night
